observations: Multiple IBC tanks stacked on pallets in an outdoor yard.
The tanks are light grey or white plastic with a metal cage frame.
Photo 1 shows a white label with '25LUTZ' on the side of one tank.
Photo 2 and 3 show the tanks from a wider angle, revealing many stacked units.
The tanks appear to be used, with some surface dirt and minor wear.
No visible brand or model name on the tanks themselves.
The seller claims a 1,000-litre capacity, but the label in photo 1 shows '25LUTZ', which is likely a 250L unit, not 1000L.
The seller's text mentions 'Intermediate Bulk Container (IBC) tank with a 1,000-litre capacity' — this is inconsistent with the visual evidence.

claims.claim: Intermediate Bulk Container (IBC) tank with a 1,000-litre capacity
claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows a label '25LUTZ', which is a 250L unit, not 1000L. The tanks appear to be 250L units, not 1000L.
Durability cannot be assessed from photos alone; no signs of cracks, leaks, or structural damage are visible, but internal condition and material quality are unknown.
